title: Understanding the Model
text: The model is given by f_theta(x)=theta_0+theta_1*veg+theta_2*(meat=beef)+theta_3*(meat=fish). Identify the values of theta from the fitted model.

title: Substituting Values
text: For the first data point, $$veg=1$$ and $$meat=beef$$. Substitute these values into the model equation.

title: Calculating the Prediction
text: Use the values $$\theta_0=-3$$, $$\theta_1=5$$, $$\theta_2=8$$, and $$\theta_3=12$$. Calculate the prediction using the equation.
